auth.label: Public API Token
auth.description: Create a Public API token in TimelinesAI under Integrations > Public API and paste it here.

actions.name: get_chat
actions.description: Get one TimelinesAI chat by its numeric chat ID.

name.description: The display name of the chat or group.

anyOf.description: The contact phone number, or null when this is a group chat.

phone.description: The contact phone number, or null when this is a group chat.

jid.description: The WhatsApp-native contact or group identifier.

isGroup.description: Whether this is a WhatsApp group chat.

read.description: Whether the chat is marked as read.

labels.description: The labels assigned to the chat.

chatgptAutoresponseEnabled.description: Whether the TimelinesAI AI Agent autoresponse is enabled for the chat.

anyOf.description: The assigned teammate email, or null when the chat is unassigned.

responsibleEmail.description: The assigned teammate email, or null when the chat is unassigned.

anyOf.description: The assigned teammate name, or null when the chat is unassigned.

responsibleName.description: The assigned teammate name, or null when the chat is unassigned.

whatsappAccountId.description: The WID of the WhatsApp account that owns the chat.

chatUrl.description: The TimelinesAI application URL for the chat.

createdTimestamp.description: The chat creation timestamp in the workspace timezone.

anyOf.description: The UID of the latest message, or null when unavailable.

lastMessageUid.description: The UID of the latest message, or null when unavailable.

anyOf.description: The latest message timestamp, or null when unavailable.

lastMessageTimestamp.description: The latest message timestamp, or null when unavailable.

unattended.description: Whether the chat is flagged as an unattended customer chat.

anyOf.description: The contact or group photo URL, or null when unavailable.

photo.description: The contact or group photo URL, or null when unavailable.

anyOf.description: Whether TimelinesAI currently allows API messages to this chat.

isAllowedToMessage.description: Whether TimelinesAI currently allows API messages to this chat.

chat.description: A normalized TimelinesAI chat with its stable routing and state fields.

actions.name: get_message
actions.description: Get one TimelinesAI message by its workspace-unique UID.

uid.description: The message UID within the TimelinesAI workspace.

chatId.description: The TimelinesAI chat ID containing the message.

receivedTimestamp.description: The timestamp when TimelinesAI received the message.

fromMe.description: Whether the message was sent from a connected WhatsApp account.

anyOf.description: The message text, or null for messages without text.

text.description: The message text, or null for messages without text.

anyOf.description: The attachment URL, or null when the message has no attachment.

attachmentUrl.description: The attachment URL, or null when the message has no attachment.

anyOf.description: The attachment filename, or null when the message has no attachment.

attachmentFilename.description: The attachment filename, or null when the message has no attachment.

status.description: The delivery or call status reported by TimelinesAI.

origin.description: The open-ended display name for the message origin.

hasAttachment.description: Whether the message has an attachment.

metadata.description: Free-form metadata whose shape depends on the message type.

createdBy.description: The teammate who created the message, or an empty string.

actions.name: get_message_status
actions.description: Get the documented delivery status history for one TimelinesAI message.

inputSchema.description: The TimelinesAI message whose status history should be read.

timestamp.description: The timestamp when the message entered this status.

history.description: The status records returned by TimelinesAI.

actions.name: get_workspace
actions.description: Get the connected TimelinesAI workspace identity, plan, and quota usage.

inputSchema.description: No input is required to get the TimelinesAI workspace.

total.description: The total allocation for the current quota period.

used.description: The amount consumed in the current quota period.

anyOf.description: The start timestamp of the quota period, when available.

periodStart.description: The start timestamp of the quota period, when available.

anyOf.description: The end timestamp of the quota period, when available.

periodEnd.description: The end timestamp of the quota period, when available.

anyOf.description: The workspace seat quota, when reported.

seats.description: The workspace seat quota, when reported.

total.description: The total allocation for the current quota period.

used.description: The amount consumed in the current quota period.

anyOf.description: The start timestamp of the quota period, when available.

periodStart.description: The start timestamp of the quota period, when available.

anyOf.description: The end timestamp of the quota period, when available.

periodEnd.description: The end timestamp of the quota period, when available.

total.description: The total allocation for the current quota period.

used.description: The amount consumed in the current quota period.

anyOf.description: The start timestamp of the quota period, when available.

periodStart.description: The start timestamp of the quota period, when available.

anyOf.description: The end timestamp of the quota period, when available.

periodEnd.description: The end timestamp of the quota period, when available.

apiCallsQuota.description: The current workspace API call quota.

anyOf.description: The remaining one-off quota balance, or null when TimelinesAI omits it.

remainingBalance.description: The remaining one-off quota balance, or null when TimelinesAI omits it.

anyOf.description: The timestamp when the one-off quota balance was last updated.

lastUpdatedAt.description: The timestamp when the one-off quota balance was last updated.

anyOf.description: The optional one-off messaging quota balance.

nonRecurringQuota.description: The optional one-off messaging quota balance.

actions.name: list_chat_messages
actions.description: List and filter messages in one TimelinesAI chat, 50 records per page.

fromMe.description: Filter outbound messages when true or inbound messages when false.

after.description: Return messages created on or after this ISO date or timestamp.

before.description: Return messages created on or before this ISO date or timestamp.

inputSchema.description: The chat and optional filters for listing TimelinesAI messages.

hasMorePages.description: Whether another message page is available.

uid.description: The message UID within the TimelinesAI workspace.

chatId.description: The TimelinesAI chat ID containing the message.

receivedTimestamp.description: The timestamp when TimelinesAI received the message.

fromMe.description: Whether the message was sent from a connected WhatsApp account.

anyOf.description: The message text, or null for messages without text.

text.description: The message text, or null for messages without text.

anyOf.description: The attachment URL, or null when the message has no attachment.

attachmentUrl.description: The attachment URL, or null when the message has no attachment.

anyOf.description: The attachment filename, or null when the message has no attachment.

attachmentFilename.description: The attachment filename, or null when the message has no attachment.

status.description: The delivery or call status reported by TimelinesAI.

origin.description: The open-ended display name for the message origin.

hasAttachment.description: Whether the message has an attachment.

metadata.description: Free-form metadata whose shape depends on the message type.

createdBy.description: The teammate who created the message, or an empty string.

messages.description: The messages returned for the chat.

outputSchema.description: A page of normalized TimelinesAI messages.

actions.name: list_chats
actions.description: List and filter chats in the TimelinesAI workspace, 50 records per page.

labels.description: Match chats having at least one of these labels.

whatsappAccountIds.description: Match chats belonging to any of these WhatsApp account WIDs.

group.description: Filter group chats when true or direct chats when false.

responsibleEmails.description: Match chats assigned to any of these teammate emails.

names.description: Match chats containing any of these case-insensitive name fragments.

phone.description: Filter direct chats by one phone number.

chatgptAutoresponseEnabled.description: Filter chats by TimelinesAI AI Agent autoresponse state.

page.description: The one-based results page, with up to 50 chats per page.

createdAfter.description: Return chats created after this timestamp.

createdBefore.description: Return chats created before this timestamp.

inputSchema.description: Filters and page selection for listing TimelinesAI chats.

hasMorePages.description: Whether another page of chats is available.

name.description: The display name of the chat or group.

anyOf.description: The contact phone number, or null when this is a group chat.

phone.description: The contact phone number, or null when this is a group chat.

jid.description: The WhatsApp-native contact or group identifier.

isGroup.description: Whether this is a WhatsApp group chat.

read.description: Whether the chat is marked as read.

labels.description: The labels assigned to the chat.

chatgptAutoresponseEnabled.description: Whether the TimelinesAI AI Agent autoresponse is enabled for the chat.

anyOf.description: The assigned teammate email, or null when the chat is unassigned.

responsibleEmail.description: The assigned teammate email, or null when the chat is unassigned.

anyOf.description: The assigned teammate name, or null when the chat is unassigned.

responsibleName.description: The assigned teammate name, or null when the chat is unassigned.

whatsappAccountId.description: The WID of the WhatsApp account that owns the chat.

chatUrl.description: The TimelinesAI application URL for the chat.

createdTimestamp.description: The chat creation timestamp in the workspace timezone.

anyOf.description: The UID of the latest message, or null when unavailable.

lastMessageUid.description: The UID of the latest message, or null when unavailable.

anyOf.description: The latest message timestamp, or null when unavailable.

lastMessageTimestamp.description: The latest message timestamp, or null when unavailable.

unattended.description: Whether the chat is flagged as an unattended customer chat.

anyOf.description: The contact or group photo URL, or null when unavailable.

photo.description: The contact or group photo URL, or null when unavailable.

anyOf.description: Whether TimelinesAI currently allows API messages to this chat.

isAllowedToMessage.description: Whether TimelinesAI currently allows API messages to this chat.

items.description: A normalized TimelinesAI chat with its stable routing and state fields.

chats.description: The chats returned on this page.

outputSchema.description: A page of normalized TimelinesAI chats.

actions.name: list_whatsapp_accounts
actions.description: List WhatsApp accounts connected to the TimelinesAI workspace.

inputSchema.description: No input is required to list connected WhatsApp accounts.

id.description: The WhatsApp account identifier in WID format.

phone.description: The connected WhatsApp phone number in international format.

connectedOn.description: The timestamp when the WhatsApp account was connected.

ownerName.description: The name of the TimelinesAI teammate who owns the account.

ownerEmail.description: The email of the TimelinesAI teammate who owns the account.

accountName.description: The WhatsApp profile name, or an empty string when unset.

raw.description: The raw TimelinesAI WhatsApp account payload.

actions.name: send_message_to_chat
actions.description: Send a plain-text WhatsApp message to an existing TimelinesAI chat or group.

text.description: The plain-text WhatsApp message, up to 2000 characters.

replyTo.description: The UID of a message in the same WhatsApp account to reply to.

inputSchema.description: The existing chat and text payload for a TimelinesAI outbound message.

messageUid.description: The UID assigned to the accepted outbound message.

outputSchema.description: A normalized TimelinesAI message submission result.

actions.name: send_message_to_phone
actions.description: Send a plain-text WhatsApp message directly to an international phone number.

phone.description: The recipient phone number in international format, including country code.

text.description: The plain-text WhatsApp message, up to 2000 characters.

whatsappAccountPhone.description: The connected WhatsApp account phone to send from; omit to use the most recently connected account.

inputSchema.description: The recipient and text payload for a TimelinesAI outbound message.

messageUid.description: The UID assigned to the accepted outbound message.

outputSchema.description: A normalized TimelinesAI message submission result.
